executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared in at least one AI answer for 100% of the traveler needs we tested, and across every individual AI answer it appeared 89.1% of the time. Together, these results show how broadly AI recognizes the hotel and how consistently a traveler would encounter it.

Leisure Travel is Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa's clearest competitive strength. The hotel appeared in 93.2% of AI answers for these searches, compared with 3.6% for the comparable hotels used in this analysis — about 25.6 times as often as the comparable hotels used in this analysis. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared in the Top 3 88% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

AI currently reflects 35.7% of the monitored facts and attributes that define the hotel, so important parts of the property proposition are not consistently represented in AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

sections.headline: Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa's priority is a Reality Gap in how a distinctive part of the proposition is represented in AI answers.
sections.keyInsight: Five Private Coves is recognized in only 6.4% of monitored answers. That is low enough to matter commercially if the attribute is part of how the hotel should win relevant traveler needs. Overall scores can hide this concentrated representation miss. Broader Scenario Presence (100%) and Consideration (89.1%) do not, by themselves, prove the distinctive attribute is traveling into answers.
sections.whyItMatters: If distinctive property attributes are weakly represented, the hotel can look broadly visible while still losing the moments where its real proposition should matter. This is a representation problem first, not automatically a peer-competition program.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on Five Private Coves. Verify first-party and major travel-source completeness for that attribute before treating the issue as a peer-competition problem. Confirm the attribute is stated clearly where AI systems are most likely to read it.
sections.whatToReview: Open Reality Gap evidence for Five Private Coves and compare recognition cues with official property pages and high-authority travel sources. Then check a small set of related demand scenarios for whether the attribute appears when competitors are named.
